literal_meaning: পেট বাঁধা বা আটকে থাকা (stomach tied or bound)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকাল খাবারের অভাবে তার পেট আঁটা হয়ে গেছে।
ঔষধ না খেলে পেট আঁটা থেকে উপায় নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to lack of fiber in his diet, he has been constipated lately.
Without taking medicine, there's no relief from being constipated.
note: This idiom is a straightforward metaphorical expression for a common physiological condition in Bengali vernacular.
